description: §5.2.3 (S435) — an inline block handler on a button inside an `<each>` row runs BOTH statements on click. Neither statement is a call and neither reads the row. Carried on impl#1 (S435, P7): the row handler keeps only the first statement.
rationale: §5.2.3 (amended S435): "On each dispatch of the event, the statements of an inline block SHALL run in source order, each one exactly once … No statement of the block SHALL be dropped … whether the handler sits at top level, inside an engine state-child (§51.0.I), or inside an `<each>` row (§17.7)." One click on the first row: a 0 → 1, b 0 → 2.
